feeds.title: Penang Insider
feeds.description: Top Penang blog, written by a resident travel writer married to a local Penang girl. Enjoy a decade of first-hand Penang experience from someone who knows the place inside out. You'll find essential tips and guides to Travel, Food, and Life on Penang, Malaysia's coolest Island.

feeds.title: Penang Foodie
feeds.description: A food blog in Penang that covers food review, the new cafe in Penang, and trending food editorials. We are a group of Penangites, that love Penang so much, especially Penang Food. And so, we set our own quest to share our little footage in discovering and exploring foods in Penang.

feeds.title: BarryBoi
feeds.description: Penang Food & Lifestyle Bloggers on Their Adventure Experiencing Penang & Malaysia Food, Events, Hotels, Attractions, Lifestyle, Travel, and more.

feeds.title: Ken Hunts Food
feeds.description: Born and bred in Penang, Ken Hunts Food is a Penang food blog written by a true Penangite. The blog records Ken's gastronomic journey in search of Penang's greatest street food and finest eats. Join him in his food adventures!

feeds.title: Steven Goh's Penang Food and Penang Lifestyle
feeds.description: Penang Food Directory. Steven Goh is an IT Marketing Manager who loves to eat and travel. The main purpose of this site is to share his findings on nice food as well as lifestyle. He provides reviews on the taste, price, food presentation, and service.

feeds.title: Penang Hyperlocal
feeds.description: A news blog of all things Penang and the northern reaches of Malaysia. Here, we share updates in the hospitality, entertainment, and travel industry and beyond.

feeds.title: Jay Chha Penang Food Blog
feeds.description: Food, Travel, and Entertainment blogger from Penang who loves sharing food hunt info, local food, cafe, and restaurant food review. Also, find fun tips on travel itinerary, backpacking, entertainment, clubs, and events.

feeds.title: On Penang
feeds.description: On-Penang is a go-to travel resource for everything you need to know for your visit to Penang Island, Malaysia

feeds.title: iNPENANG
feeds.description: Your premier Society & Tourism Magazine for Penang

feeds.title: PenangToday
feeds.description: Our site provides you quick and easy access to vital information on everything Penang. We cover important events, lifestyle, travel & food.

feeds.title: Penang Property Talk
feeds.description: PenangPropertyTalk.com is a site aiming to provide quality, accurate and update-to-date information to anyone who are keen on property news and new launches in Penang. As the name of our domain name suggests, we are determine to provide you a space to discuss anything about Penang properties.

feeds.title: What2seeonline
feeds.description: A blog featuring the best of Penang Food. Author CK Lam constantly combs Penang for the best gastronomical delights and loves promoting Penang Cuisines, Culture, Heritage, and Events.

feeds.title: Now Eating
feeds.description: Now Eating is a frequently-updated blog providing unbiased reviews on food enjoyed by the author, together with a gallery of genuine photos, maps, and contact information.

feeds.title: The Penang Birder
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Choy Wai Mun, based in Penang, Malaysia. This blog is all about birding in Penang and beyond - from all my memorable birding experiences to the birding tours that I conduct for visiting birders and bird photographers.

feeds.title: Penang House Of Prayer
feeds.description: Read up to know what's on our hearts and what we've been up to. We are building a 24/7 House of Prayer for all nations in the spirit of the tabernacle of David that is a nexus of worship, intercession, and missions established in the heart of Penang.

feeds.title: Penang Local Stuff
feeds.description: Blog site about Penang, a beautiful island in Malaysia. The author's goal is to share his personal knowledge, experience, and thoughts about living in Penang.
